task_definition: Two-stage evaluation: reuse the exact L3 v19 strongest-blocker output, then choose one executable L4 action for exactly that selected blocker.
geometry_policy: Original corrected R/F/M measurements, sorted visible-object records only. Hidden-object records excluded; remaining measurements unchanged.
gt_policy: Corrected source L3 reason unchanged. Valid blocker set intersected with visible IDs to match the original output validator.
prompt_change: Arbitrary valid blocker choice replaced by strongest-blocker/first-removal selection; scalar blocker_id schema retained.
comparison_note: The current 25-scene set has no scene with multiple visible valid blocker IDs, so blocker ranking quality cannot be directly evaluated.
matrix_definition: C0-C6 crossed with D4/D8, 25 scenes, five fixed seeds; corrected v19 images and geometry are held fixed.
source_v19_task_note: Only the frozen inputs are inherited from v19. The native L4 task and output schema are action selection, not L3 blocker-reason classification.

stage_policy.stage_1: Frozen L3 v19 blocking_reason and strongest blocker_id
stage_policy.stage_2: L4 action selection conditioned on the frozen blocker
stage_policy.blocked_case: non-NONE requires non-target action on selected blocker only
